deniedGlobals.window: Node has no `window`, and the crypto core must run there. Use `globalThis`.
deniedGlobals.document: Node has no DOM, and the crypto core must run there. Take the data as an argument.
deniedGlobals.indexedDB: The crypto core holds no state. Store keys in the client and pass them in.
deniedGlobals.localStorage: The crypto core holds no state. Store data in the client and pass it in.
deniedGlobals.Buffer: Browsers have no `Buffer`, and the crypto core must run there. Use `Uint8Array`.
deniedGlobals.process: Browsers have no `process`, and the crypto core must run there. Take the value as an argument.

patterns.message: `@armadoc/crypto` is published on its own, so a file outside its folder is missing once installed. Move the code into `packages/crypto/src`.
Browsers have no Node built-ins, and the crypto core must run there. Use `globalThis.crypto` and other web-standard APIs.
